title: 第13章 初级魔法中的奇葩第14章 意外的逮捕
slug: 你好是寄往魔神堡垒的信吗
lines: 【随机初级魔法48正在抽取中......】
【重复的魔法，将会加持在宿主对这个魔法的熟练度中】
【恭喜宿主获得......】
【金系初级魔法——坚硬7→坚硬lv3】
【木系初级魔法——促生术7→促生术lv3】
【水系初级魔法——造水术4→造水术lv2】
【火系初级魔法——点火术6→点火术lv3】
【土系初级魔法——岩甲术5→岩甲术lv2】
【电系初级魔法——电火花5→电火花lv2】
【风系初级魔法——漂浮术5→漂浮术lv2】
【冰系初级魔法——冷冻术3→冷冻术lv2】
【黑暗系初级魔法——疾走2→疾走lv2】
【光系初级魔法——照明术3→照明术lv2】
【灵魂系初级魔法——清醒术1→清醒术lv1】
一股庞杂而基础的知识洪流涌入脑海，林鬼却只是无奈地叹了口气。
五行下位元素魔法，3项中位元素魔法、2项上位元素魔法，还有一个偏门的灵魂魔法。
几乎所有魔法种类都凑齐了。
可惜，全是初阶的。
若是刚入行那两年得到这些，他怕兴奋得三天三夜合不拢眼。
为了啃完那厚得能砸死人的魔法典籍。
从零开始构建法术模型，他不知付出了多少心血。
若有这般直接灌注技能的奖励，又何至于浪费整整两年光阴？
他随意吟唱了几个音节，指尖“滋啦“迸出几缕微弱的电火花。
林鬼吊着死鱼眼，从墙角薅了一根狗尾巴草，操控着电火花慢慢灼烧。
一分钟后，草叶边缘才勉强泛起一丝焦黄。
这威力，怕是连给人挠痒痒都嫌不够劲。
这也正是他对这些初级魔法，提不起丝毫兴趣的原因。
太弱了。
目光淡淡扫过那十种初级魔法。
本只是随意一瞥，却猛地定格在【漂浮术】上。
“！！！怎么没想到！初级魔法里还藏着这么一位爹啊！！“
法师公会对魔法等级的界定，通常基于魔力输出功率。
阶位越高的魔法，消耗越大，威力越恐怖，学习难度也呈几何级数飙升。
但偏偏有一个初级魔法，完全违背了这一定律。
content_en:
[Random primary magic 48 is being drawn...]
[Repeated magic will be added to the host’s proficiency in this magic]
[Congratulations to the host for getting...]
[Primary magic of the metal system—Hardness 7→Hardness lv3]
[Elementary magic of the wood system - growth promotion 7 → growth promotion lv3]
[Elementary Water Magic——Water Making 4→Water Making lv2]
[Primary Fire Magic——Ignition 6 → Ignition lv3]
[Earth primary magic - Rock Armor 5→Rock Armor lv2]
[Electric primary magic——Electric Spark 5→Electric Spark lv2]
[Wind primary magic——Levitation 5→Levitation lv2]
[Elementary magic of the ice system——freezing 3→freezing lv2]
[Dark primary magic——Speed 2→Speed lv2]
[Primary magic of light system——Illumination 3→Illumination lv2]
[Soul-based primary magic - Awakening 1 → Awakening lv1]
A torrent of complex and basic knowledge poured into his mind, but Lin Gui just sighed helplessly.
Five elements of lower elemental magic, 3 mid-level elemental magics, 2 high-level elemental magics, and a partial soul magic.
Almost all types of magic are gathered together.
Unfortunately, they are all beginner level.
If he had gotten this in the first two years of his career, he would have been so excited that he could not close his eyes for three days and three nights.
In order to finish the magic book that is so thick that it can kill people.
He didn't know how much effort he put into building the spell model from scratch.
If there is such a reward that directly infuses skills, why waste two whole years?
But now...
He chanted a few syllables at random, and a few weak electric sparks burst out from his fingertips.
Lin Gui looked at the dead fish eyes, picked up a piece of foxtail grass from the corner, and controlled the electric spark to slowly burn it.
After a minute, the edges of the grass blades barely showed a hint of brown.
"..."
This power may not even be enough to tickle someone.
This is why he has no interest in these elementary magics.
Too weak.
His eyes swept over the ten primary magics.
It was just a casual glance, but it suddenly focused on [Levitation Technique].
"!!! Why didn't I expect that there is such a father hidden in elementary magic!!"
The Mages Guild's definition of magic level is usually based on magic output power.
The higher the level of magic, the greater the consumption, the more terrifying the power, and the difficulty of learning increases exponentially.
But there happens to be a primary magic that completely violates this law.
title_en: Chapter 13 Weirdness in Elementary Magic Chapter 14 Unexpected Arrest
